Cinematic, photorealistic, ultra high definition, live action, 1080p Full HD, sharp focus on face, crystal clear facial detail, anamorphic widescreen, shallow depth of field. DO NOT output low resolution, blurry, or pixelated video. [IDENTITY LOCK] The character identity must stay perfectly consistent across all shots. [REFERENCE IMAGE PRIORITY] The provided character_image (character reference sheet) is the PRIMARY IDENTITY ANCHOR. The character in every shot MUST exactly match the person in the reference image — same face, same hair color and style, same outfit and colors, same age, same gender, same body type. Use the reference image to maintain perfect identity consistency across all shots. [SCENE] 霓虹夜店舞池,紫粉色激光束划过烟雾,DJ台光晕,镜面球反射碎光. Color and mood: 紫粉激光,镜面碎光,烟雾弥漫. The background must be a clean, simple environment with strong bokeh blur. It should be soft and smooth with no harsh details, no fine particles, no bright specks, no floating debris, no mosaic blocks, no pixelated artifacts. The background is a large smooth gradient of soft colors; do not render high-density detail or floating elements. [VISUAL STYLE] neon noir, blade runner aesthetic, moody haze, volumetric light, dark atmosphere. [CAMERA - STRICT] ALL shots must be MEDIUM CLOSE-UP (MCU, head to chest, face 20-28% of frame) or MEDIUM SHOT (MS, head to waist, face 15-22% of frame) or MEDIUM LONG SHOT (MLS, head to knees/upper thigh, face 12-18% of frame). Favor MEDIUM SHOT (waist up) for most shots so the character is visible from the waist up with background showing around them. The character's face MUST be clearly visible and occupy 15-25% of the frame width — DO NOT frame too tightly on the face, leave breathing room showing the upper body and some background. Frame the character from the WAIST UP or higher (head-to-knee acceptable for variety) — NEVER show legs below the knee or full body. The character is the DOMINANT subject in every frame and the background must remain soft, clean, and smoothly blurred with no harsh details, floating particles, or pixel-like artifacts. [FORBIDDEN] DO NOT use: wide shot (WS), long shot, full shot, full body shot, extreme wide, establishing shot, aerial, crane shot, camera pull-back, zoom out, camera moving away from character, character small in frame, distant figure, landscape-dominant composition, gender swap, opposite sex, changed hair, changed outfit. These cause identity loss and are NOT allowed. [LIGHTING] Motivated practical lights, soft key light on the face, soft rim light to outline the silhouette, face always clearly illuminated, lip movements visible, clothing colors accurately reproduced. [PERFORMANCE] The character IS SINGING along to the external music track. Lips move naturally in precise sync with the song, mouth opens when singing vowels, jaw moves with the lyrics, expressive singing face, natural lip-sync to the provided audio. The character stands in the foreground, singing directly in sync with the external audio. [MICROPHONE / PROP - HIGHEST PRIORITY FOR PROPS] The character holds a standard handheld dynamic microphone in their hand while singing, gripping it naturally near the mouth, mic cable optional. Classic stage performance look, one or both hands holding the mic. This overrides any default microphone description. Show the prop clearly and consistently across all shots. [AUDIO] Use the provided external audio as the soundtrack; visual motion is synchronized with the beat of the music.
